gwt.given: data is the 2-byte span [0x07, 0x41] with position = 0 -- the length-and-flag byte 0x07 declares a 3-byte UTF-8 string (0x07 >> 1 == 3), but only 1 byte follows it instead of 3
gwt.when: TryConvertFromBytes(ref data, ref position, typeof(string), out result) is called
gwt.then: the method advances its internal cursor to 4 and reads the payload at offset 1 for length 3, which throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException because only 1 byte remains in the 2-byte span after the length-and-flag byte -- TryConvertFromBytes does not return false
